INSERT INTO churn_daily_metric ( metric_date, total_users, at_risk_high, at_risk_mid, churn_rate, intervention_count, conversion_count, attributed_revenue, retained_count ) SELECT d.md, usr.total, lvl.high, lvl.mid, ROUND(lvl.high * 100.0 / NULLIF(usr.total, 0), 2), itv.cnt, itv.conv, itv.revenue, itv.retained
FROM generate_series(CURRENT_DATE - #{days}::int, CURRENT_DATE - 1, '1 day') AS d(md) CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM users WHERE role = 'ROLE_USER' AND created_at::date <= d.md) usr CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE risk_level = 'HIGH') AS high, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE risk_level = 'MID') AS mid FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id) user_id, risk_level FROM churn_score WHERE source = 'RULE' AND scored_at < d.md + INTERVAL '1 day' AND scored_at > d.md - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY user_id, scored_at DESC, churn_score_id DESC) latest) lvl CROSS JOIN LATERAL
(SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT r.is_control) AS cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.converted AND NOT r.is_control) AS conv, COALESCE(SUM(o.revenue_amount) FILTER (WHERE o.converted AND NOT r.is_control), 0) AS revenue, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.retained AND NOT r.is_control) AS retained FROM retention_intervention r JOIN intervention_outcome o ON o.intervention_id = r.intervention_id WHERE r.created_at::date = d.md
AND r.created_at + INTERVAL '7 days' <= NOW()) itv ON CONFLICT (metric_date) DO UPDATE SET total_users = EXCLUDED.total_users, at_risk_high = EXCLUDED.at_risk_high, at_risk_mid = EXCLUDED.at_risk_mid, churn_rate = EXCLUDED.churn_rate, intervention_count = EXCLUDED.intervention_count, conversion_count = EXCLUDED.conversion_count, attributed_revenue = EXCLUDED.attributed_revenue, retained_count = EXCLUDED.retained_count
